markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Invasive only; second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100% | One dominant class |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 90th pct | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Neighbors all match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign stroma/fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce; low score associated with invasive · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score associated with invasive · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Low score associated with invasive; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score associated with invasive; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful: removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005–0.007); not shown to reflect classifier. Mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) degrades input; reliability score only modestly ranks errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration is imperfect on a small test set (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **0, 5, 9** — Confirm tumor-infiltrating stroma; concept passed spot check (19/20).
2. **7** — Confirm scarce benign stroma/fat, a validated feature.
3. **0, 4, 8** — Count mitoses yourself; the model's mitosis score failed spot check.
